headline: Site plan extension for 860 Spring Street, Village Review Overlay Zone ordinance changes, and Riverwalk North project from Bridge Street to Garfield Street.
summary: The meeting will cover a request to extend site plan approval at 860 Spring Street. It will also cover proposed changes to the Village Review Overlay Zone and a workshop on the Riverwalk North project.
items: Fourth extension request for site plan approval at 860 Spring Street, Boulos Asset Management, extending approval through November 1, 2027
Land use ordinance amendment to § 335-7.1 Village Review Overlay Zone review process
Workshop on Riverwalk North site plan in the Shoreland Zone, City of Westbrook: an 8-foot riverwalk from Bridge Street to Garfield Street
location: Westbrook High School – Room 114, 125 Stroudwater Street
plain_text:
Page 1 of 1 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Westbrook Planning Board 
 
Tuesday, November 3, 2026, 7:00 P.M.  
Westbrook High School – Room 114 
125 Stroudwater Street 
This meeting will be offered as a hybrid meeting, accommodating both in-person and remote participation. 
Where public comment is permitted, members of the public attending remotely will have the opportunity to 
provide remote oral testimony. If you wish to speak during a Public Hearing or Public Comment, use the “Raise 
Hand” function through Zoom (or dial *9 on your phone) when instructed by the Planning Board chair. 
Zoom Link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81700741385 
Dial-in (audio only): 1-646-558-8656 Webinar ID: 817 0074 1385 
AGENDA 
1. Call to Order 
 
2. Minutes – October 6th, 2026 
REGULAR BUSINESS 
 
3. 22-000604 – Site Plan Approval Extension Request – 860 Spring Street – Boulos Asset Management: The 
applicant is requesting a fourth extension of the approval granted on November 1, 2022, for a 15,240sf 
building addition located at 860 Spring Street. The requested extension would extend the approval date by 
one year, through November 1, 2027. Tax Map: 003 Lot: 101A Zone: Industrial Park District  
                                                                                  
NEW BUSINESS 
 
4. 26-000847 – Land Use Ordinance Amendment - § 335-7.1 Village Review Overlay Zone: The proposed 
amendments include modifications to the Village Review Overlay Zone review process as a part of a City-
wide initiative to review the structure and procedures of City boards, committees, and commissions for 
consistency with legal requirements and local practices. 
 
WORKSHOP 
 
5. 26-000913 – Site Plan, Shoreland Zone – Riverwalk North – City of Westbrook: The proposed project 
includes an 8-foot wide riverwalk extending from Bridge Street to Garfield Street. The riverwalk will 
consist of a multimodal path with at-grade paved sections and elevated boardwalk segments in areas 
where existing site constraints limit at-grade construction. Tax Map: 032 and 039, Lots: 223 and 031, Zone: 
City Center District and Residential Growth Area 1
